disputes.topic: Exact flight-line acquisitions and stitching evidence are absent
disputes.issue: The packet cites the PACUNAM initiative and research publication but does not identify the exact flight acquisitions or retain raw point clouds, flight-line list, calibration/registration inputs or reproducible processing log. The 2,100 km² and 100+ flight-line assembly claims are not demonstrated by this packet.
evidence: README.txt: source context and missing inputs
disputes.required_resolution: Identify the contributing flight acquisitions and retain or durably reference raw data, calibration, registration parameters, overlap evidence and processing logs. Rebuild the assembly history from actual inputs.

disputes.topic: Archaeological classification and legacy validation result lack source evidence
disputes.issue: The TIR retains provisional pyramid/causeway hypotheses and a natural-hill rejection, while OI gives specific dimensions/orientations and the validation report claims VALID. No raw LiDAR evidence is retained to independently review these decisions; the report therefore overstates what the repository can establish.
evidence: OI.json: entity dimensions, classification and component candidature
TIR.json: provisional hypotheses and rejected candidate
disputes.required_resolution: Retain source point-cloud regions and measurable observations supporting each geometric claim; separate observed morphology from archaeological interpretation; rerun validation against actual source data. Until then, keep the candidate classification unresolved and validation blocked.
